tier_anchors.notes: California Faucets: best combined cartridge sourcing (Flühs + Kerox), PVD finishes, StarCraft near-perfect. In2aqua: Kerox PVD+ 4M cycles, best warranty per StarCraft. Waterstone: best body material (316 SS bar stock), true manufacturer, but Geann cartridges and no PVD finish.
DST cartridge (5M cycles), Brilliance PVD finish. BUT: not all Brizo models use DST (some Sedal/unknown), >2/3 China manufacturing, plastic spray wands.
Same DST tech as Brizo on -DST suffix models. ZAMAK shell + PEX waterway (-1 dock from solid brass). Massive parts availability. Must specify -DST models.
Marketeer importing from 3-4 Chinese factories. Uses mixed cartridges (Kerox, Flühs, Sedal, Kuching, Hain-Yo) but won't disclose which is in which faucet. 5-year cartridge warranty only.
Reserved for uncertified/contraband faucets, products failing UPC/NSF gate, or brands with active safety recalls.

quality.notes: 316 SS machined bar stock = best (Waterstone monoblock). Solid brass = standard premium. ZAMAK + PEX = good innovation but not solid construction (-1 from brass). ZAMAK in wetted path = disqualifying concern.
Machined bar stock (monoblock) eliminates casting voids. Cast = standard. Die-cast = zinc shell method.

Flühs (German) and Kerox (Hungarian) are Tier 1-2 cartridge manufacturers. Geann (Taiwanese) is adequate but below Flühs/Kerox. DST (proprietary) = Kerox/Maruwa ceramic + diamond coating, Delta-assembled. Unknown/mixed = consumer cannot verify what's installed. Cartridge manufacturer IS the spec for faucets (equivalent to hardware brand for cabinets).

PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) = most durable finish technology. Brilliance PVD (Brizo/Delta by Vapor Technologies) = proven. Chrome = standard. Powder coat/lacquer = adequate but not PVD-grade durability.

Manufacturer = machines/fabricates own parts (Waterstone). Assembler = designs and hand-assembles from selected components (California Faucets, In2aqua). Marketeer = imports finished goods from OEM factories (Kraus).
Same rule as all categories. Single source/plant = +1. Multi-source = 0. Unknown factories = -1.

durability.notes: Kerox PVD+ tested to 4M cycles. DST tested to 5M cycles. Flühs/Geann 500K+. Standard ceramic ~100-250K.
Warranty exclusion consistency rule (Rule 18) applies. Score on term + backing entity viability.
Cartridge is the primary wear component. Excluding it from warranty is a significant durability signal. Kraus: 5-year cartridge warranty only — 'not nearly adequate' per StarCraft.

PVD lifetime guarantee = highest confidence (Brizo Brilliance). Standard lifetime on chrome = expected. Limited on decorative finishes = common. Waterstone describes colored finishes as 'semi-durable'.
Excellent = stocked at major distributors (Delta/Brizo via Masco network). Good = available direct from manufacturer (Waterstone, In2aqua). Limited = short-term guarantee only (Kraus 5-year parts).

performance.notes: Performance is essentially flat for faucets — all deliver water at regulated rates. Proprietary spray tech (Brizo MagneDock/ShieldSpray) earns +1. Performance axis weight is 0.10.
WaterSense = EPA voluntary certification, exceeds federal minimum. Federal only = meets legal requirement. Non-compliant = illegal for US sale (gate failure).

scoring_rules: Health certs report-only, no composite impact (NSF 61, NSF 372 — these are gate certifications, not differentiators)
UPC certification is a gate: non-certified = not scored, flagged as potentially illegal for US sale
Cartridge manufacturer IS the spec for faucets — equivalent to hardware brand for cabinets (Blum MOVENTO 100K+ vs generic 25K)

Score the product not the brand (Rule 19): Waterstone two-handle (Geann) and Waterstone single-handle (Geann) are same product. Brizo DST and Brizo Sedal are DIFFERENT products. Delta -DST and Delta Classics are DIFFERENT products.
Performance axis essentially flat (weight 0.10) — all faucets deliver water at regulated rates. Spray technology is the only meaningful differentiator.
Source traceability same as all categories (+1 single source, 0 multi, -1 unknown)
StarCraft Pool S — primary independent source for faucet quality assessment

Business model scoring: manufacturer > assembler > marketeer. Assembler is NOT penalized — designing and hand-assembling from selected top-tier components (California Faucets, In2aqua) is a legitimate quality model.

ZAMAK rule: ZAMAK/zinc in non-wetted ancillary parts = acceptable (In2aqua). ZAMAK as outer shell with PEX waterway = -1 dock from solid brass (Delta). ZAMAK in wetted path = disqualifying Material Safety concern.

sources: StarCraft Independent Reviews — systematic component-level analysis, cartridge identification, business model verification. Best Value awards. Only independent faucet teardown source in public domain.
